notes: Numbers come only from the sources named per game/weapon; null = not found. Damage in each game's own HP; distances and speeds in metres. See SOURCES.md for conversions and confidence.

games.name: Doom (1993) deathmatch
games.armor: Green and blue armor pickups (values not taken from the cited source).
games.units: Map units, 1 unit = 2.54 cm by the same convention used for Quake (Doom's real proportions are looser). Weapon timing in tics, 35 tics per second; fire intervals are the attack-state tics with A_ReFire looping back.

weapons.name: Fist
weapons.notes: 2-20 per punch (2*(1d10)), average 11; Berserk multiplies by 10. Interval 4+4+5+4 tics.

weapons.name: Chainsaw
weapons.notes: 2-20 per tick (2*(1d10)), average 11; a hit every 4 tics.

weapons.name: Pistol
weapons.notes: 5-15 per bullet (5*(1d3)), average 10; first shot perfectly accurate, refire spreads. 14 tics per shot.

weapons.name: Shotgun
weapons.notes: 7 pellets of 5-15 (average 10 each). 37 tics per shot.

weapons.name: Super Shotgun
weapons.notes: 20 pellets of 5-15 (average 10 each), wide spread. 57 tics per shot (Doom II).

weapons.name: Chaingun
weapons.notes: 5-15 per bullet, average 10; 4 tics per bullet (8.75/s).

weapons.name: Rocket Launcher
weapons.notes: Direct 20-160 (20*(1d8)), average 90, plus radius damage 128 at the centre falling 1 per unit to 0 at 128 units. Speed 20 units/tic = 700 u/s. 20 tics per shot.

weapons.name: Plasma Rifle
weapons.notes: 5-40 per bolt (5*(1d8)), average 22.5; 3 tics per bolt (11.7/s); 25 units/tic = 875 u/s.

weapons.name: BFG9000
weapons.notes: Ball 100-800 (100*(1d8)), average 450, then 40 tracers of 15-120 each (15 rolls of 1d8, average 67.5). Fire cycle 20+10+10 tics derived from the weapon states (the A_ReFire state is skipped while held).

games.name: Quake
games.armor: Green / yellow / red armor pickups (values not taken from the cited source).
games.units: Quake units, 1 unit = 2.54 cm (1 inch) convention.

weapons.name: Nailgun
weapons.notes: 9 per nail; two barrels alternate each 0.1 s animation frame (10 nails/s); 1000 u/s.

weapons.name: Super Nailgun
weapons.notes: 18 per nail, 10/s, 2 nails of ammo each.

weapons.name: Grenade Launcher
weapons.notes: Explodes on contact with a player or after 2.5 s; radius damage 120 minus half the distance (findradius 160 units). Launched at 600 u/s plus 200 up.

weapons.name: Rocket Launcher
weapons.notes: Direct 100-120 (100+random*20), average 110; the target hit gets no extra splash. Splash 120 minus half the distance, radius 160 units.

weapons.name: Thunderbolt
weapons.notes: 30 per 0.1 s (300 DPS), trace 600 units; discharges all cells (35 x cells radius damage) in water.

games.name: Quake II
games.armor: Jacket / combat / body armor and power armor (values not taken from the cited source).
games.units: Quake units, 1 unit = 2.54 cm. Server runs 10 frames/s; fire interval = (FRAME_FIRE_LAST - FRAME_ACTIVATE_LAST + 1) x 0.1 s from Weapon_Generic, deathmatch values.

weapons.name: Chaingun
weapons.notes: 6 per bullet in deathmatch (8 SP); spins up from 1 to 2 to 3 bullets per 0.1 s frame (30/s at full spin).

weapons.name: Grenade Launcher
weapons.notes: 120 damage, radius damage+40 = 160 units, 2.5 s fuse.

weapons.name: Hand Grenade
weapons.notes: 125, radius 165 units; thrown at 400-800 u/s by hold time, 3 s fuse.

weapons.name: Rocket Launcher
weapons.notes: Direct 100-120 (average 110) plus 120 radius damage over 120 units (1-sqrt(dist/radius) falloff).

weapons.name: Railgun
weapons.notes: 100 in deathmatch (150 SP), pierces. Community wikis list ~38 shots/min.

weapons.name: BFG10K
weapons.notes: Ball 200 in deathmatch (500 SP), lasers hit targets within 256 units of the ball; explosion radius 1000 units. Fires on frame 17 after a 0.8 s wind-up.
